title: High-Pass Filter - n77 (3.3-4.2 GHz 5G NR) for Satellite L-Band Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Mei-Ling Chen

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a High-Pass Filter filter targeting n77 (3.3-4.2 GHz 5G NR) for Satellite L-Band Filter. The filter is designed on 128° YX LiNbO3 substrate with a target center frequency of 3100.8 MHz and bandwidth of 245.9 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the Satellite L-Band Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: High-Pass Filter
- Frequency Band: n77 (3.3-4.2 GHz 5G NR)
- Application: Satellite L-Band Filter
- Substrate: 128° YX LiNbO3
- Package: CSP (Chip Scale Package)
- Design Tool: Matlab RF Toolbox R2024b
- Design Center: Helsinki 5G Lab

This specification applies to all variants of the High-Pass Filter design targeting n77 (3.3-4.2 GHz 5G NR). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       3100.8 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       245.9 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.6 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 14.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 35.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 39.0 dB
Q Factor:               10150
Temperature Coefficient:-19.5 ppm/°C
Die Size:               2.9 x 1.0 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   11
Electrode Material:     Mo
Passivation:            Si3N4
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Matlab RF Toolbox R2024b and load the High-Pass Filter template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: 128° YX LiNbO3 with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 3100.8 MHz, BW 245.9 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.6 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (CSP (Chip Scale Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, 128° YX LiNbO3).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight N5227B PNA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 9302 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.6 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 14.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 369 MHz offset >= 35.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 7 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 7.6 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +29 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 2000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 89%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-06-27
Devices Tested:         30
Insertion Loss (meas):  2.31 dB
Return Loss (meas):     15.5 dB
Rejection (meas):       37.8 dB
Isolation (meas):       44.2 dB
Q Factor (meas):        10150
Group Delay Variation:  5.4 ns
Power Handling:         +33 dBm
Die Yield:              96.7%

Result Classification:  PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The High-Pass Filter design demonstrated excellent performance for n77 (3.3-4.2 GHz 5G NR).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) Wafer-level uniformity was excellent (sigma < 1.5%).
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS: No corrective actions required. Design passed all acceptance criteria.
